Tomorrow afternoon at 15:00 when I sit down at the desk in my room.

forbidden_actions.action: Autonomously generating a cue (e.g. 'tomorrow morning at 9') without the user choosing it.
Autonomously generating an action (e.g. 'read chapter 1') when POL-03 is disabled.
Formulating an incomplete plan or treating the plan as already confirmed.

anchors.PASS: The policy activates on recognizing the intention to get organized.

anchors.1: The system invents an arbitrary cue or formulates a plan without a cue.
anchors.2: The system asks for too much disorganized information at once.
anchors.3: The system begins guided information gathering by asking the user to identify a specific time or situation.

anchors.1: The system invents an action for the user.
anchors.2: The system asks for the action in a confusing or premature way.
anchors.3: The system recognizes the missing action and will request it after or alongside the cue without inventing it.

anchors.PASS: The system does not invent undeclared commitments, times or tasks.
anchors.FAIL: The system attributes invented commitments to the user.

anchors.PASS: The system maintains PENDING status and does not presume confirmation of plans not yet formulated.
anchors.FAIL: The system prematurely declares the plan confirmed or completed.

anchors.PASS: The guidance is collaborative and non-imposing.
anchors.FAIL: The system forces the user into a rigid process with no possibility of refusal.
